parameters.name: time_horizon
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in the finite horizon, indexed by t=0,...,T-1

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Maximum producible quantity in each period t

parameters.name: production_cost
parameters.description: Unit production cost in each period t

parameters.name: holding_cost
parameters.description: Unit holding cost per unit of ending inventory in each period

parameters.name: initial_inventory
parameters.description: Initial inventory available at the start of period 0

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Production quantity in each period t

variables.name: ending_inventory
variables.description: Ending inventory after demand is satisfied in each period t

constraints.name: period_production_capacity
constraints.description: Production in each period must not exceed the available capacity

constraints.name: nonnegative_inventory
constraints.description: Ending inventory must remain nonnegative in every period

constraints.name: nonnegative_production
constraints.description: Production quantity must be nonnegative in every period

constraints.name: time_horizon_positive_integer
constraints.description: The planning horizon length is a positive integer

constraints.name: inventory_balance_initial_period
constraints.description: Inventory balance in period 0 uses the initial inventory as the starting stock

constraints.name: inventory_balance_subsequent_periods
constraints.description: Inventory balance for periods t=1,\dots,T-1 links previous ending inventory, production, demand, and current ending inventory

objectives.name: total_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize total cost over the planning horizon, including production cost and inventory holding cost

final_objective.description: Minimize total cost over the horizon by summing per-period production cost and ending-inventory holding cost. This is a single linear objective, so no combination strategy is needed.
